text: I am feeling pretty low today.
I am not happy with how today went.
I smiled at everyone today but felt lonely inside.
Wonderful, another deadline missed and another night without sleep.
I feel relieved and grateful that my friends supported me.
I was nervous earlier but now I feel happy about my progress.
I am proud of myself for finishing a difficult assignment.
I attended two lectures and returned home at five.
My exam is scheduled for Monday morning.
I wrote down tomorrow's tasks in my notebook.
